# Real-data fixture

Small synthetic files in the shapes of the measured real-data files that the realism bands point into, with hand-checkable numbers. No figure here comes from real matches. The compressed events files (`wy2_events.csv.gz`, and the StatsBomb-shaped `sb_events.csv.gz` and `sb2_events.csv.gz` of the whole-distribution test) are written by the tests at run time.
